meta.name: Generate Image (MOSS Turbo, Kromoss 8-step)
meta.licenseNote: Kromoss (lodestones, 2026-10) is Apache-2.0, a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image-Base; its 8-step DMD2 LoRA is Apache-2.0; the Qwen3.5-9B text encoder is Apache-2.0. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion moss-image/turbo): Kromoss (lodestones/Kromoss, diffusion_models/kromoss_int8_convrot) with its 8-steps-dmd2-lora unmerged at strength 1, 8 Euler steps on MOSS's shift-5 schedule, CFG 1 (no negative pass), the FLUX.2 small decoder. The low-VRAM choice: on cards under 20 GB the text encoder and the DiT take turns on the card (about 10 GB peak). The LoRA may sit up to two folders deep in loras/ (loras/moss-image/).
meta.creator: lodestones · OpenMOSS
meta.description: Fast, low-VRAM text to image (8 steps, fits 12 GB)
